remarks: Welcome to this beautiful 4 bedroom 3 Bath cape located on a quiet cul-de-sac close to town. The home has an open floor plan with gourmet kitchen that opens up to the dining area and family room with a freestanding wood-burning stove. Formal living room has a bay window and a fireplace with wood-burning insert. Main floor has a bedroom with an adjacent full bath. The second floor has a large primary with a walk in closet and 2 additional bedrooms, a full bathroom and a laundry room. Full spacious finished basement perfect for an office, play room and/or gym. Fenced-in yard, a large patio and backyard completes this home. Some recent updates include new kitchen appliances, new boiler and water heater, newer washer and dryer, fresh interior paint, as well as a Tesla charger. The house is also hooked up for a generator.
